findings.text: follow-on: the tree-digest annotation is asserted equal to tree_digest(maps_dir/"jt-60sa") computed by the same function on the same directory, so the assertion moves with the code and cannot catch a tree_digest regression; the dedicated digest tests at :163-187 are what guard that capability.

follow-on: `assert all("git" not in ref for ref, _ in registry.pushes)` is near-vacuous because a ghcr.io package ref can never contain "git", so the no-git-tag property the docstring names is not actually guarded by this line.

follow-on: release writes the released version into the local bundle.json before the push at :455, so a failed push leaves the local descriptor naming a version that was never published; it self-heals because the digest excludes the version field, but a reader of the file between the write and a successful retry sees an unpublished version.
